channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula abre vantagem após notícias ligando Flávio Bolsonaro a Vorcaro, mostra Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll released Friday morning shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva gaining a numerical lead over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in a potential runoff, following news linking Bolsonaro’s son to Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master. The survey was conducted after the revelation of the alleged relationship between Flávio Bolsonaro and Vorcaro, which negatively affected Bolsonaro’s electoral standing.

item.title: Queda de marqueteiro de Flávio expőe racha entre moderados e ideológicos
item.description: The departure of marketer Marcello Lopes from Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign exposes an internal split between moderate and ideological factions, mirroring divisions seen during Jair Bolsonaro’s government. This rupture highlights disagreements over campaign direction, strategy, and messaging. The episode underscores the fragility of cohesion within the Bolsonarist orbit ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Zema eleva críticas a Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Quem estiver do lado de corrupto năo conte comigo'
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for President from the Novo party, sharply criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, stating he would not support anyone aligned with corrupt figures. The remarks suggest a potential break with Bolsonarism, intensifying tensions within Brazil’s right-wing political spectrum.

item.title: Lula e Janja reúnem ministros para discutir combate à fome
item.description: Lula and Janja met with ministers to discuss the FAO's Global Alliance Against Hunger and Poverty, launched in November 2024 with 13 countries and 17 ongoing projects, and offices in Rome, Brasília, Ethiopia, Thailand, and Washington D.C. Brazil exited the Hunger Map in 2025 after re-entering it between 2018 and 2020 due to cuts in social programs, with 24 million people leaving severe food insecurity by the end of 2023. Lula emphasized that hunger is a political choice, resulting from government and economic decisions that ignore or promote inequality.

item.title: Lula discutirá obras e combate ao crime com presidente do Suriname
item.description: President Lula will meet with Suriname's President Jennifer Geerlings-Simons in Brasília to discuss infrastructure projects, a northern Brazil maritime route, food security, and strengthened cooperation against transnational organized crime, aiming for concrete solutions to boost bilateral trade and Amazon stability.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula absolve compradores de celulares roubados
item.description: President Lula was criticized for suggesting that buyers of stolen smartphones should not be punished, contradicting Article 180 of the Brazilian Penal Code, which penalizes receptivity even when there are signs of illicit origin, such as suspiciously low prices. The statement drew backlash for ignoring consumer responsibility in curbing the market for stolen goods. The O Antagonista post frames the remark as an improperly attributed absolution by the president.

item.title: Datafolha: Rejeição a Flávio Bolsonaro sobe após revelação de conversas com Vorcaro e supera numericamente a de Lula
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) rejection rose from 43% to 46% after revelations of conversations with Vorcaro in the 'Dark Horse' case, surpassing Lula’s (PT) rejection, which dropped from 47% to 45%. Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) has 31% rejection, not previously tested. Other pre-candidates remain under 20%.

item.title: Lula tem 47% e Flávio 43% no segundo turno, aponta pesquisa
item.description: Lula leads with 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 43% in a technical tie within the margin of error for the second round. In the first round, Lula expands his lead to 40% versus 31% for Flávio, based on a Datafolha survey conducted May 20–21 with 2,004 in-person interviews.

item.title: Datafolha: Michelle Bolsonaro tem 43% contra 48% de Lula em simulação de segundo turno
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Michelle Bolsonaro at 43% versus Lula's 48% in a hypothetical 2026 presidential runoff, with 8% blank/null votes and 1% undecided. The former first lady replaced Flavio Bolsonaro in the simulation after the 'Dark Horse' scandal involving his alleged undisclosed talks with Banco Master's Daniel Vorcaro. The PL party will decide by early June whether to keep Flavio in the race, amid Jair Bolsonaro's insistence and allied discomfort over the revelations.

item.title: As intenções de voto de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno em novo Datafolha
item.description: Lula regained the lead in a hypothetical second-round runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro, with 47% voting intentions compared to 43%, according to a new Datafolha poll released after the disclosure of conversations between the senator and banker Daniel Vorcaro regarding multimillion-dollar transfers for a Jair Bolsonaro propaganda film. The survey, conducted with a margin of error of two percentage points at 95% confidence, shows 9% would vote blank or null and 2% are undecided. The result confirms a trend previously indicated by AtlasIntel and contrasts with the technical tie recorded before the audio leak.

item.title: Governo vai estabelecer subsídio de R$ 0,44 por litro de gasolina, diz ministro do Planejamento
item.description: Planning Minister Bruno Moretti announced the government will establish a subsidy of R$ 0,44 per liter of gasoline, with a monthly cost of R$ 1,2 billion, to be offset by increased oil revenue from international markets. The decree will be presented to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva next Monday and will be paid directly to producers and importers via the ANP, aiming to cushion the price shock from the Middle East conflict-driven oil surge. The subsidy will initially apply to gasoline and may be extended to diesel after a current provisional measure expires.

item.title: Zema eleva críticas a Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘Quem estiver do lado de corrupto não conte comigo’
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's presidential pre-candidate, intensified his criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro, stating he is 'breaking with what I have always condemned' following the revelations of Flávio's conversations with banker Daniel Vorcaro, whom Zema labeled a 'crook'. Zema emphasized he never used his family name for political gain and declared he would not support anyone aligned with corruption, questioning the credibility of such alliances.

item.title: Após subir impostos nos últimos anos, governo estima nível recorde para a arrecadação em 2026
item.description: The government estimates that tax and federal revenue collection will reach 23.6% of GDP in 2026, a record level matching 2010, following years of tax increases. The fiscal 'recomposition' policy led by Finance Minister Dario Durigan emphasizes tax justice, with relief for workers and income tax exemptions for 10 million people, while reversing benefits and taxing high incomes, offshore entities, betting, and interest on equity.

item.title: Fachin propõe padronizar penduricalhos em contracheque único
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Edson Fachin, president of the STF and CNJ, proposed a resolution to establish a single paycheck for all judiciary magistrates, featuring a Unified Remuneration Table that standardizes the nomenclature of all payroll items, including additional payments. The measure aims to eliminate parallel payment slips and increase transparency by requiring courts to publish detailed breakdowns of earnings. The CNJ plenary will review the proposal on May 26, with a 60-day adaptation period if approved.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula abre vantagem sobre Flávio após 'Dark Horse'
item.description: In the first Datafolha poll following the 'Dark Horse' scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, President Lula (PT) expanded his lead in the first-round simulation from 3 to 9 points, reaching 40% voting intention against 31% for the Bolsonarist senator.

item.title: Kassio indica Mendonça para atuar em ações sobre propaganda eleitoral no TSE e fecha lista de relatores do pleito deste ano
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques appointed André Mendonça as auxiliary judge for electoral propaganda matters, alongside Minister Estela Aranha. The official gazette published a directive stating that preliminary decisions on electoral propaganda will be immediately submitted to the TSE Plenary, possibly for virtual judgment. Mendonça's inclusion reflects Kassio's aim to foster a more collaborative leadership.

item.title: O encontro entre Lula e Motta para amarrar texto final da PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta is set to meet with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva by next Monday to finalize the text of the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule. The goal is to vote on the proposal in the special committee and plenary by the end of next week, with the transition period being the central topic of discussion. Motta also plans to meet with rapporteur Leo Prates and party leaders to secure a strong vote, as even the opposition acknowledges the proposal’s popular and electoral appeal.

item.title: A expectativa da campanha de Lula sobre a candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign coordinator, Senator Camilo Santana, assessed that the case involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former banker Daniel Vorcaro could influence voter perception in the 2026 presidential election, raising questions about the candidate's discourse consistency and political ties. He noted such episodes affect public perception and that the Lula campaign is monitoring developments closely, while refraining from definitively judging Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy viability, stating that voters will ultimately decide.

item.title: O preço do futuro (parte 2)
item.description: The text examines the evolution of political event prediction markets, particularly for elections, contrasting regulated platforms like Kalshi (overseen by the CFTC in the U.S.) with decentralized ones like Polymarket. The core debate is whether these contracts should be classified as financial instruments or as forms of betting, with significant implications for regulation, market integrity, and participant protection. In Brazil, it remains unclear which authority — CVM, Central Bank, or another — should oversee such markets.

item.title: Os próximos capítulos da investigação contra Lulinha no STF
item.description: The Federal Police found compromising messages from Lulinha, son of President Lula, with individuals investigated in the billion-dollar INSS fraud scheme, raising suspicions of undue interference in the investigation. Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça may act to investigate possible obstruction of justice. Lulinha’s defense, led by lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, denies knowledge of the messages, asserts his innocence, and states he wishes to cooperate with the investigations.

item.title: Kassio e Mendonça cuidarão de processos no TSE sobre propaganda eleitoral
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques appointed Minister André Mendonça as an auxiliary judge for electoral propaganda, alongside Minister Estela Aranha. The three will oversee the distribution and adjudication of electoral propaganda-related cases, including injunctions and right-of-reply requests, with decisions submitted to the TSE plenary, including virtually. The cases will cover fake news, electronic voting machine attacks, AI, and social media.

item.title: Ficha Limpa: Cármen Lúcia vota contra reduzir prazo de inelegibilidade
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia voted to overturn changes to the Clean Record Law made by Complementary Law 219/2025, advocating for a return to stricter timelines for ineligibility. Her vote could reinstate the ineligibility of politicians such as Eduardo Cunha, Anthony Garotinho, and José Roberto Arruda, impacting their 2026 candidacies. The STF ruling, ongoing until May 29, may restore the original rigor of the law regarding mandate loss, resignation, and convictions for corruption and improbity.

item.title: Clica e Confirma: presidente do TSE afirma que tecnologia fortalece a democracia
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Nunes Marques, stated that technology, including Artificial Intelligence, strengthens democracy when combined with transparency and public oversight. The Clica e Confirma program also explained how the 'virtual piggyback' works for campaign fundraising, allowed from May 15, and detailed the services available to voters after the electoral roll closed on May 6, with reopening scheduled for November 3.

item.title: "Bloco da ilegalidade nunca foi tão forte e unido no Brasil", diz Dino
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino stated that the 'bloc of illegality' has never been as strong and united in Brazil, citing armed groups, money laundering, distorted parliamentary amendments, and the trading of judicial decisions. He emphasized that the STF is not the nation's enemy but a permanent guardian of the Constitution, during an event where he received an honorary doctorate from PUC-SP.

item.title: A avalanche de recursos de ex-assessor de Moraes em julgamento no STF
item.description: The STF has begun ruling on seven appeals filed by Eduardo Tagliaferro, former aide to Minister Alexandre de Moraes, charged with breach of functional secrecy, coercion, obstruction of investigation, and attempted violent abolition of the Democratic Rule of Law. So far, only Moraes has voted, rejecting all appeals; the verdict is expected by May 29, pending votes from Flávio Dino, Cristiano Zanin, and Cármen Lúcia. The case is in the final arguments phase and will determine whether Tagliaferro is convicted or acquitted.

item.title: Mendonça vai atuar na análise da propaganda eleitoral, decide Nunes Marques
item.description: The president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), Minister Nunes Marques, appointed Minister André Mendonça to serve as an auxiliary judge in electoral propaganda analysis. The appointment was published in the Official Gazette of the Union on Friday, the 22nd. The document also notes that Minister Estela Aranha had previously been designated for the same role.

item.title: O efeito imediato do escândalo para Flávio Bolsonaro, segundo cientista político
item.description: The Banco Master scandal is creating fissures in the right and threatening the electoral viability of Flávio Bolsonaro, according to political scientist Eduardo Grin. While both government and opposition publicly avoid supporting a CPMI on Banco Master due to fears of politicization in an election year, Grin states that Flávio Bolsonaro is the one who most fears deepening investigations, as it could undermine his anti-corruption image and turn the issue into a 'glass ceiling' for his 2026 candidacy.

item.title: STF autoriza partidos a atuarem em ação sobre inelegibilidade
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia of the STF authorized parties and entities as amici curiae in ADI 7.881, which examines the constitutionality of Complementary Law 219/2025, altering inelegibility periods under the Clean Record Law. The virtual judgment is set to conclude by May 29, 2026 and is being watched by politicians barred from running who aim to return in the 2026 elections, including Eduardo Cunha, Anthony Garotinho, and José Roberto Arruda.

item.title: Crusoé: A luta pela sobrevivência dos nanicos
item.description: Small political parties, including PRTB, PMB, PSTU, PCO, PCB, UP, DC, Mobiliza and Agir, face the threat of extinction due to the TSE's electoral barrier clause and reduced public funding, turning the 2026 presidential election into a battle for their survival. Although they lost access to party funds for failing to meet minimum thresholds, they remain active in the electoral race, seeking relevance and resources. Their struggle highlights the tension between democratizing access to power and the representativeness criteria imposed by electoral justice.

item.title: Bolsonaro atua para tentar salvar Flávio e conter tensão com Michelle
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro is acting to mitigate the damage to his son Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential pre-campaign after revelations about Flávio’s financial and political ties with banker Daniel Vorcaro sparked criticism over lack of transparency. Bolsonaro urged Flávio to disclose the full truth and demanded a definitive financial accounting of the film 'Dark Horse', while allies admitted narrative mismanagement. The crisis has also reignited internal conservative debates about alternatives, including Michelle Bolsonaro’s name, prompting Jair Bolsonaro to reaffirm his support for Flávio’s candidacy.

item.title: Crusoé: “Natural que ele tivesse proximidade”, diz Valdemar sobre Flávio e Vorcaro
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL party, said it was 'natural' for Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro to have proximity with banker Daniel Vorcaro, whom he approached for funding a film about Jair Bolsonaro. The statement was made to Veja magazine, highlighting the connection between the pre-candidate and the former Master controller. The comment arises amid discussions about political and financial influences in the 2026 election campaign.

item.title: Após “Dark Horse”, Michelle empata com Flávio contra Lula no 2º turno
item.description: The Futura poll shows Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro performing similarly against Lula in a potential runoff, with Michelle at 41.6% and Flávio at 42.2% of voting intentions, both trailing the president by about 6 points. The margin of error is 2.2 percentage points. The survey was conducted days after the leak of an audio in which Flávio negotiated R$134 million with Daniel Vorcaro for funding the film 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: Reunião sobre maioridade penal na Câmara mostra PT ainda distante da pauta da segurança pública
item.description: A CCJ meeting on reducing the age of criminal responsibility to 16 showed complete absence of PT deputies, while right-wing legislators attended in force. The only left-wing voice was Talíria Petrone (PSOL-RJ), who unsuccessfully attempted to block the proposal. The Lula government seeks to claim ownership of the public security agenda despite poor evaluations in polls like Datafolha.

item.title: Terceira via tem janela estreita para se viabilizar com discurso anticorrupção
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy faces growing risks from leaked conversations and the erosion of the Bolsonaro brand, opening a narrow window for an anti-corruption 'third way.' Voters, weary of both Lula and the Bolsonaro legacy, are more open to new leadership, though few competitive alternatives have yet emerged. The viability of such a candidate depends on the short campaign period, which only gains broad traction among voters starting in August.

item.title: Corte da Itália conclui julgamento final sobre recurso de Zambelli contra extradição para o Brasil
item.description: Italy's Supreme Court of Cassation ruled on the appeal filed by former deputy Carla Zambelli against her extradition to Brazil. The decision, considered final in the Italian judicial system, will be communicated to her lawyers in the coming hours. The case involves allegations of electoral crimes and abuse of power in Brazil.

item.title: Renan Santos defende processamento de terras-raras no Brasil
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential pre-candidate for the Missão party, argues Brazil should move beyond rare earth extraction and invest in domestic processing of critical minerals to attract high-tech industries, semiconductors, and data centers. He proposes leveraging the Northeast’s renewable energy potential to attract tech firms and criticizes the critical minerals bill in Congress for loopholes and influence from Centrão-linked lobbies seeking to avoid industrial counterparties. Santos also pledges fiscal frankness inspired by Javier Milei, supporting pension reform, Central Bank autonomy, privatization of Correios, but opposing Petrobras privatization.

item.title: TSE: Nunes Marques e Mendonça cuidarão das ações relacionadas a propaganda eleitoral
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques appointed himself and Vice President André Mendonça to oversee electoral propaganda actions for the 2026 elections, alongside Minister Estela Aranha. The order mandates that preliminary injunctions, including right of reply analyses, be immediately submitted to the plenary for possible virtual voting. Electoral propaganda is considered sensitive due to issues like disinformation, attacks on voting machines, AI use, and post removals.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Mentiu de novo, Flávio?
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program accused Flávio Bolsonaro of repeating lies tied to the Banco Master crisis and his connections with banker Daniel Vorcaro, while also covering the approval of a bill that loosens donation rules for municipalities. The segment suggests a pattern of misinformation by the lawmaker amid financial scandals involving his name.

item.title: Lula ganha fôlego na Futura/Apex e vira disputa de segundo turno contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Futura/Apex poll shows Lula (PT) at 43% in the first round, 6 points ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), above the margin of error. In a runoff, Lula leads 48% to 42%, increasing his lead to 5.5 points. Excluding blank and null votes, Lula reaches 52% of valid votes, suggesting a potential first-round victory.

item.title: Lula reforça dobradinha com Nísia Trindade em visita ao Rio
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attends the swearing-in of cardiologist Roberto Kalil Filho as a full member of the National Academy of Medicine in Rio de Janeiro, alongside former Health Minister Nísia Trindade, reinforcing their political alliance. On Saturday, both will visit the new headquarters of the Technological Development Center in Health (CDTS/Fiocruz), underscoring Nísia’s legacy as the first woman to lead Fiocruz in over a century and her role in expanding its scientific capacity before becoming Health Minister. Their joint appearance signals a strengthening of Lula’s electoral base in Rio ahead of the 2026 re-election bid.

item.title: TSE reforça estrutura para análise da propaganda eleitoral nas Eleições 2026
item.description: The TSE issued a directive appointing Minister André Mendonça as an auxiliary judge for electoral propaganda analysis in the 2026 elections, serving alongside Minister Estela Aranha. Signed by TSE President Nunes Marques, the measure mandates that decisions on injunctions and right-of-reply requests be immediately referred to the full Court, including via virtual sessions, and will be subject to a plenary referendum.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia vota para barrar mudanças na Lei da Ficha Limpa
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cármen Lúcia voted to declare unconstitutional provisions of a Complementary Law that reduced the ineligibility period under the Clean Record Law (Ficha Limpa). The judgment began in a virtual plenary session on Friday, the 22nd, in the Direct Action of Unconstitutionality (ADI) filed by the Sustainability Network. So far, only her vote has been disclosed.

item.title: Carmen Lúcia vota para derrubar mudança na Lei da Ficha Limpa que reduz prazo de inelegibilidade
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cármem Lúcia voted to declare unconstitutional a change to the Clean Record Law that reduces the ineligibility period for ousted politicians, advocating for the restoration of prior rules. She argued the congressional amendment, signed by Lula with vetoes, weakens the law and threatens accountability. The virtual plenary judgment continues until November 29, pending votes from Flávio Dino, Cristiano Zanin, and Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Botafogo lança primeiro uniforme em parceria com a Mizuno; veja fotos
item.description: Botafogo unveiled its first uniform in partnership with Mizuno for the 2026/27 season, drawing inspiration from 1940s designs and featuring commemorative patches honoring the 1942 merger and 1904 founding. The black-and-white and white kits were revealed, blending historical elements with modern technology. The uniform will debut in the upcoming match against São Paulo in the Brazilian Championship.

item.title: Crusoé: Maioria não acha que áudios mudam opinião sobre Flávio, indica Futura/Apex
item.description: A Futura/Apex poll reveals that 71.5% of respondents believe the leaked audio messages from Flávio Bolsonaro to banker Daniel Vorcaro did not change their opinion of the PL presidential pre-candidate. Only 18.7% said the conversations negatively affected their perception. The findings suggest limited electoral impact from the audio scandal.

item.title: STF julga programa de escolas cívico-militares de Tarcísio
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) resumes the judgment of direct actions of unconstitutionality against the law that established the civic-military schools program in the state of São Paulo, signed by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas. The vote, under the rapporteurship of Minister Gilmar Mendes, takes place in the virtual plenary and ends on May 29, 2026. The plaintiffs (PSOL and PT) argue that the law invades the Union's exclusive competence in education and allows the discretionary replacement of tenured teachers by military personnel.

item.title: Suplente de Alcolumbre é indiciado pela PF em investigação sobre fraudes em licitações de R$ 60 mi
item.description: A substitute for Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil - AP) has been indicted by the Federal Police in an investigation into suspected fraud in DNIT procurement contracts in Amapá, involving R$ 60 million. The probe is part of a broader scheme concerning fraudulent public contracts in transportation infrastructure.

item.title: Lei garante acesso de crianças e adolescentes à saúde mental no SUS
item.description: Law 15.413/2026 guarantees universal access to mental health services in the SUS for children and adolescents, including prevention, treatment, free medication, and professional training. The law amends the Child and Adolescent Statute to include basic and specialized psychosocial care, emergency and urgent care, and hospital care. Signed by President Lula without vetoes, it originated from Bill 4.928/2023 by Senator Damares Alves and aims to combat high suicide and mental health disorder rates among Brazilian youth.

item.title: Sancionada Semana Nacional de Promoção da Pesca Artesanal
item.description: President Lula signed Law 15.414/2026, establishing the National Week for the Promotion of Artisanal Fishing, celebrated annually during the week of June 29 in honor of Saint Peter. The law aims to valorize artisanal fishing, raise awareness about its importance for food security, and encourage public policies supporting the sector and its value chain, preserving traditional knowledge and promoting environmental sustainability.

item.title: Pix é do Temer, Master é de todos
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro appeared at a rally in Florianópolis wearing a shirt that read 'Pix is Bolsonaro’s, Master is the PT’s', sparking a political debate over the origins of Brazil’s Pix payment system and the ownership of Mastercard. The statement sought to credit the Bolsonaro government with Pix while blaming the PT for Mastercard’s influence, despite Pix being launched by the Central Bank in 2020 under Bolsonaro’s administration. The reference to 'Jim Caviezel in a wig' implies a distorted or caricatured perception of current political reality.
